# Analytic Madhyasth Darshan

> Rigorous analytic studies of Madhyasth Darshan (Co-existentialism). Catalog reads are public. Write APIs are for humans; see /auth.md.

## Start here

- [Studies catalog](https://analyticmadhyasthdarshan.org/Studies/index.html): topical, formal, and applied papers
- [Unified catalog JSON](https://analyticmadhyasthdarshan.org/Studies/catalog-all.json): all rows with a collection tag
- [Change feed](https://analyticmadhyasthdarshan.org/Studies/feed.json): JSON Feed of draft and released Edited-on dates
- [Glossary](https://analyticmadhyasthdarshan.org/Studies/glossary.json): shared terms used across studies
- [API catalog](https://analyticmadhyasthdarshan.org/.well-known/api-catalog): RFC 9727 linkset
- [MCP Server Card](https://analyticmadhyasthdarshan.org/.well-known/mcp/server-card.json): Streamable HTTP at /mcp
- [Auth](https://analyticmadhyasthdarshan.org/auth.md): identity policy for agents

## Studies

- [The Ontology of Coexistence](https://analyticmadhyasthdarshan.org/Studies/The-Ontology-of-Coexistence/The-Ontology-of-Coexistence.md): Madhyasth Darshan's account of existence as the coexistence of satta and units — saturation, the four orders, sentience, causation, conservation, and the reality of the world — compared in depth with Advaita Vedanta and modern physics and philosophy (topical, released)
- [Nature of Time](https://analyticmadhyasthdarshan.org/Studies/Nature-Of-Time/Nature-Of-Time.md): What time (kaal) is: the duration of unit-activity against timeless satta, numerical reckoning, and the past–present–future structure — compared with Advaita Vedanta, the philosophy of time, and physics (spacetime, cosmology, entropy) (topical, released)
- [Why Humans Are Not Just Material](https://analyticmadhyasthdarshan.org/Studies/Why-Humans-Are-Not-Just-Material/Why-Humans-Are-Not-Just-Material.md): Whether a human being is reducible to an insentient physicochemical body: Madhyasth Darshan's body-and-jeevan account compared with scientific evidence, its physicalist interpretation, and Advaita Vedanta, followed by a critical review of all three frameworks (topical, released)
- [The Epistemology of Coexistence](https://analyticmadhyasthdarshan.org/Studies/The-Epistemology-of-Coexistence/The-Epistemology-of-Coexistence.md): What knowledge is, who the knower is, and what can be known: coexistence, jeevan, humane conduct, evidence, and epistemic error — compared with Advaita Vedanta, modern Western philosophy, and natural science (topical, released)
- [Axiology: Value Theory](https://analyticmadhyasthdarshan.org/Studies/Axiology-Value-Theory/Axiology-Value-Theory.md): Madhyasth Darshan's theory of value: what values are, how they are recognised and fulfilled, and how mutual satisfaction grounds a humane axiology (topical, released)
- [Ethics and Morals in Human Beings](https://analyticmadhyasthdarshan.org/Studies/Ethics-And-Morals-In-Human-Beings/Ethics-And-Morals-In-Human-Beings.md): Whether ethics is divine command, convention, evolution, reason, or evidence of understanding: Madhyasth Darshan's account of humane conduct through justice, dharma, truth, and right-use, compared with Advaita Vedanta and modern moral science (topical, draft)
- [Family Relationships and Values](https://analyticmadhyasthdarshan.org/Studies/Family-Relationships-And-Values/Family-Relationships-And-Values.md): The family as the first site of values: recognising relationships and living trust, affection, gratitude, and mutual satisfaction (topical, draft)
- [Aesthetics](https://analyticmadhyasthdarshan.org/Studies/Aesthetics/Aesthetics.md): What beauty and art are: Madhyasth Darshan's functional aesthetics of usefulness, harmony, and human purpose, compared with modern philosophical aesthetics and Advaita Vedanta (topical, draft)
- [Human Behavior and Society](https://analyticmadhyasthdarshan.org/Studies/Human-Behavior-And-Society/Human-Behavior-And-Society.md): Humane conduct and social organisation in Madhyasth Darshan, compared with the natural sciences, Advaita Vedanta, and religious and technocratic approaches (topical, draft)
- [How to Form Self-Sustaining Organizations](https://analyticmadhyasthdarshan.org/Studies/How-To-Form-Self-Sustaining-Organizations/How-To-Form-Self-Sustaining-Organizations.md): Examines Madhyasth Darshan's claim that organisations grounded in fear or accumulation become extractive, and its account of organisations that sustain themselves without instrumentalising their members (topical, released)
- [Spiritual Practice and Realization](https://analyticmadhyasthdarshan.org/Studies/Spiritual-Practice-And-Realization/Spiritual-Practice-And-Realization.md): Realization and awakening in Madhyasth Darshan: anubhav, samyama, upasana, and liberation from mystery, compared with Advaita Vedanta and with modern philosophy of religious experience and contemplative science (topical, draft)
- [How Undivided Society Is Established](https://analyticmadhyasthdarshan.org/Studies/How-Undivided-Society-Is-Established/How-Undivided-Society-Is-Established.md): Madhyasth Darshan's account of how undivided society is established through coexistence, justice, family, institutions, and education — compared with science-only materialism, Advaita Vedanta, and Hindu religious authority (topical, released)
- [Coexistence from First Principles](https://analyticmadhyasthdarshan.org/Studies/Coexistence-From-First-Principles/Coexistence-From-First-Principles.md): A layered reconstruction of Madhyasth Darshan's ontological core, activity-duration, order-relative stability, and knowledge-order cycles, with explicit boundaries between textual doctrine, formal organization, mathematical analogy, and open posits (formal, draft)
- [From Unit Activity to Human Orderliness: A State-Dynamic Reconstruction of Coexistence](https://analyticmadhyasthdarshan.org/Studies/A-State-Dynamic-Model-Of-Coexistence/A-State-Dynamic-Model-Of-Coexistence.md): A source-bounded typed qualitative reconstruction linking intrinsic unit activity, compositional closure, T1 jeevan, animal and human joint forms, reflexive evaluation, and public orderliness. It distinguishes dharma and niyati-kram from causal forces, preserves composition and atomic development as separate lines, and keeps unresolved empirical mechanisms explicit. (formal, draft)
